description: Sync storyboard state across tabs via storage events

tasks.title: Create CollaborationProvider
tasks.description: Add a provider that listens to storage events and rehydrates state.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/components/CollaborationProvider.tsx exists
Uses window.addEventListener('storage', ...) for keyframe-storage
Calls useStore.persist.rehydrate() when keyframe-storage changes
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Added CollaborationProvider with storage listener and rehydrate call.

tasks.title: Guard storage rehydrate logic
tasks.description: Avoid rehydrating on unrelated storage changes or null values.
acceptanceCriteria: Storage handler ignores events where key !== keyframe-storage
Storage handler ignores events with empty newValue
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Ignored non-matching keys and empty newValue in storage handler.

tasks.title: Wire CollaborationProvider in layout
tasks.description: Wrap the app with CollaborationProvider for all routes.
acceptanceCriteria: src/app/layout.tsx wraps children with CollaborationProvider
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Wrapped app with CollaborationProvider in layout.

tasks.title: Add sync indicator to Header
tasks.description: Show a small sync status label in the Header.
acceptanceCriteria: Header shows text "Sync: On"
Label uses text-xs and muted color
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Added Sync: On label to Header actions.

tasks.title: Browser test: sync indicator visible
tasks.description: Verify the sync indicator renders in the Header.
acceptanceCriteria: agent-browser: open http://localhost:3000 - page loads
agent-browser: snapshot -i - Sync: On text visible
tasks.notes: Verified Sync: On visible via browser search highlight.

tasks.title: Browser test: cross-tab template sync
tasks.description: Verify template selection syncs across two tabs.
acceptanceCriteria: agent-browser: open http://localhost:3000 - tab A loads
agent-browser: open http://localhost:3000 - tab B loads
agent-browser: in tab A, connect OpenAI with test-key-dev
agent-browser: in tab A, select Problem → Solution template
agent-browser: in tab B, template selection updates and frames reflect the template
tasks.notes: Tab A selection updated tab B frames to Before/During/After.

tasks.title: Browser test: cross-tab template switch
tasks.description: Verify another template switch syncs across tabs.
acceptanceCriteria: agent-browser: in tab A, select Raskin Pitch template
agent-browser: in tab B, frames update to The Old World / The Shift / Winners & Losers
tasks.notes: Tab B updated to Raskin Pitch frames after switch.

tasks.title: Browser test: sync persists after reload
tasks.description: Verify tab B still shows updates after reload.
acceptanceCriteria: agent-browser: reload tab B
agent-browser: frame list still reflects selected template
tasks.notes: Playwright reload verified Raskin Pitch persisted after refresh.
